prompt: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering of a wide side-scrolling arcade shooter stage backdrop, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, crisp pixel-art texture accents, subtle CRT scanline glow, a deep-navy space background that is never pure black. The scene is built as clean horizontal parallax bands stacked from top to bottom. Top band: lifted deep-navy near-space with a dense field of small hard white and pale-blue stars and one faint cyan nebula wisp. Second band: the enormous curved rim of a blue planet sweeping gently across the whole width, deep ocean blue under a glowing thin cyan atmosphere line, its edge bright where a sun hides off-frame to the left. Third band: flat outlined shelves of white and pale-blue cloud drifting over the planet surface in two staggered rows. Fourth band: rolling green-teal continents seen from high above, terraced mint plateaus, dark teal forest canopies and thin silver rivers glinting. Bottom band: a near ridge of pale mint and teal rock pinnacles with dark outlines, a crisp silhouette edge that could tile left to right. At the far right, tiny against the planet, a long dark angular fortress-ship silhouette hangs in orbit with a single pinprick of red underlight. Calm, blue, patient mood before an invasion. No characters, no ships in the foreground, no text, no letters, no user interface.
negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, watermark, logo, UI elements, pure black background, oversaturated neon, spaceship cockpit, human figures, frame border, letterboxing
